answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 1178 Country: WS Title: Please let me know about Muwatta Imam Malik and Muwatta Imam Muhammad, whether both are containing same ahadeeth or what? Which one is to be preferred in terms of hadith studying and fiqh knowledge? Please reply as soon as possible. Question: Please let me know about Muwatta Imam Malik and Muwatta Imam Muhammad, whether both are containing same ahadeeth or what? Which one is to be preferred in terms of hadith studying and fiqh knowledge? Please reply as soon as possible. Answer ID: 1178 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 761/761=J) Muwatta Malik and Muwatta Muhammad do not have same type of Hadiths. Muwatta Malik contains some Hadiths which are not found in Muwatta Muhammad while Muwatta Muhammad consists of some traditions which are not available in Muwatta Malik. The narrator of Muwatta Malik, Yahya bin Yahya Al-masmudi Al-andalusi has collected the traditions and derivations (Ijtehad) of only Imam Malik, while Imam Muhammad has collected the traditions of his other teachers along with Imam Malik. Moreover, Muwatta Muhammad enjoys such characteristics as per Hadith and Fiqh which are missing in Muwatta Malik. Therefore, to me, Muwatta Muhammad is better for studying Hadith and Fiqh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
